newsitem.title: USA: Rio Hotel shrs climb on positive sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Rio Hotel shrs climb on positive sentiment.

text.p: Shares of Las Vegas hotel/casino operator Rio Hotels Inc rose one to 17-1/8 by late Wednesday amid positive sentiment that has sent the stock rising 17 percent since it announced second quarter results.
On July 17, Rio reported second quarter earnings of $0.31 a share, beating the financial analysts' consensus of $0.28 a share. The day before its report, Rio shares closed at 14-1/2.
"A lot of investors are becoming more interested in the company, given their success in beating analysts' estimates," said Andrew Zarnett, analyst at Ladenburg, Thalmann.

As important, the company also announced on July 17 that it has completed the Rio Hotel's expansion with a new hotel tower, new casino, retail space and other amenities meant to add tourist traffic to Rio's core market of local customers.
Rio owns about 40 acres adjacent to the Las Vegas hotel, which it expects to develop at some point in the future.
Rio shares currently trade near their year high price of 18 back in February.
Company officials were not immediately availble to comment about the recent stock activity.
